title: Uncovered Mysteries

sources.title: Detect Thoughts
markers: only the creature’s Intelligence is used

summary: Cast Detect Thoughts or wear this amulet to unlock eligible dialogue options.

fields.Detect Thoughts: Level 2, self Action once per Long Rest. Concentration until Long Rest. During eligible dialogue, attempting to read a creature’s thoughts uses Intelligence in the reported implementation. Failure can make the creature hostile.
fields.Passive access: Simply equipping the amulet can make the dialogue option available without casting in advance.
fields.Acquisition: Small gilded chest on the basement mezzanine next to the Arcane Tower elevator exit.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
